title: Overnight Oats with Mixed Berries
instructions: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, honey & salt in a jar.
Stir in the berries.
Refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hrs).
Stir in the morning and enjoy.
tip: Multiply ingredients into mason jars for grab‑and‑go breakfasts.

title:
Veggie & Cheese Egg 

 Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Whisk eggs, season, stir in veggies & cheese.
Grease muffin tin, fill ¾ full, bake 18–20 min.
Cool & store in fridge.
tip: Reheat in microwave for a quick breakfast.
